faqs.a: Yes, CareerAI is 100% free. All features are available without credit card or subscription.
Your data is protected and is never shared with third parties.
The RIASEC quiz is based on Holland's model. It analyzes your professional interests in 30 questions to recommend suitable careers.

faqs.q: Can I use CareerAI in Arabic?
faqs.a: Yes. CareerAI supports French, English, and Arabic with a full RTL interface.
Once your CV is created, click Export PDF to download a professional document ready to send.

faqs.q: Can AI really help me find a job?
faqs.a: CareerAI optimizes your CV for ATS filters, identifies your strengths, and prepares you for interviews.
